purpose: Teach: 追記/新装/賞与/取り調べ/動員/次期/顕著/買い付け

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 規約に、本気で、絶対、追記、絶対、必要な箇所、絶対、ありますね
lines.en: There are definitely sections in the terms and conditions that need to be updated, aren't there?
lines.style: Efficient, direct opener. Matter-of-fact tone, clipped pace. Speaking as someone moving through a checklist with purpose. Slight upward inflection on the final question mark—inviting confirmation, not doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。支店の、本気で、絶対、新装、絶対、開店、絶対、ご招待、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively pushing forward with the branch renovation and grand opening invitations. Really appreciate your support.
lines.style: Steady, measured affirmation. Warm but businesslike. Slight emphasis on the progress—a light lift on 「進めております」—showing momentum. Trailing gratitude is genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今期の、本気で、絶対、賞与、絶対、お知らせ、絶対、社員に、絶対、送りましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we send the bonus announcement to all staff this quarter.
lines.style: Clear directive. Leader-level clarity without harshness. Moderate pace, confident attack on the opening word. A slight downward settle on the final syllable—decision made, now we move.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先方の、本気で、絶対、取り調べ、絶対、結果、絶対、待っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're waiting on the results from the other party's investigation right now. Thank you for handling this.
lines.style: Patient, informed update. Warm undertone—acknowledging the effort being made. Slight pause before 「待っております」, showing attentiveness. Gratitude lands as genuine partnership, not obligation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: チームの、本気for、絶対、動員、絶対、戦略、絶対、立てましょう
lines.en: We should develop a clear team mobilization strategy.
lines.style: Thoughtful directive. Measured pace, slightly lower in register—this is serious planning talk. Soft attack on the opening, building to the main idea. Invitational rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、次期、絶対、計画、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm compiling our plan for next term right now. I appreciate you keeping us on track.
lines.style: Competent, grounded affirmation. Steady pace. Shows active ownership of the task. The final thanks is warmer, more personal—acknowledging the person, not just the work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業績の、本気で、絶対、顕著、絶対、な、絶対、改善、絶対、見られますね
lines.en: The performance improvements have been quite marked, haven't they?
lines.style: Reflective observation, not a question demanding answer. Quieter attack, slightly slower pace. A note of quiet satisfaction underneath—noticing and appreciating what's been built. Trailing-off suggests shared recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外の、本気で、絶対、買い付け、絶対、ルート、絶対、開拓、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively developing new overseas purchasing routes. I'm grateful for your leadership through this expansion.
lines.style: Confident close. Decisive on the forward momentum—a light emphasis on 「開拓」. Warmer emotional register here, wrapping up. The final gratitude carries both respect and genuine thanks for the journey.
